canon_ref.note: Day 99 is a guess (after Christmas, before the soups). Anand and Belgrade are named as leaders for the strike force. Xrn has not told the Grand Queen about her levels. Rhir is a real continent (it matters in later books).

b5.d_xrn_shares_her_plan_with_klbkch.summary: Xrn finds Klbkch in his room and admits the Individuals have worth. The Queens have stopped trying to make new Queens. She plans a strike force of Individuals to sail to Rhir for a Queen or the lost knowledge, and Klbkch says it must come sooner.

stage.line: Lyonette sets a jar on the bar with care. The fat larva inside has gone still and hard. She looks tired, and oddly pleased with herself.
stage.note: M13.1: a scene. Hours are guesses (the morning before Bird comes in). Erin and Lyonette talk over her new levels.

hooks.news: Lyonette told another Human at the inn about her new levels. It was the first time she said them out loud without shame.

canon_ref.note: Day 100 is a guess (ADR 0020). Apista is her pet bee larva. Erin gives her pay and a gold coin for Mrsha.

b5.e_lyonette_levels_and_apista_pupates.summary: Lyonette levelled in the night and gained two new classes: [Beast Tamer] and [Carer]. Her pet larva Apista is hardening into a pupa. Erin promises her a real wage and sends her and Mrsha into Liscor with money to spend.

stage.line: A tall Antinium with a bow on his back drops a lumpy sack on a table. It smells very bad. He looks very happy.
stage.note: M13.1: a scene. Hours are guesses (early afternoon). The sack holds two-week-old birds; Erin offers to cook fresh ones for free.

hooks.news: Bird has a new friend at the inn: a Human who listened to all of his bird facts, and asked for more.

canon_ref.note: Day 100 is a guess (ADR 0020). Bird eats some birds raw; the rest go to the Hive as paste. The birds in the sack are about two weeks old. Lyonette makes Mrsha throw the maggot out.

b5.f_bird_brings_erin_his_birds.summary: Bird explains that he loves birds, and so he shoots them. He opens a sack of old, rotten ones, and Mrsha grabs a maggot. Erin makes him a deal: bring her fresh birds and she will cook them for him for free.

b5.g_erin_sells_soup_samples_at_the_guil.news: Erin Solstice gave out soup samples by the Adventurers' Guild. One makes scales too hard for a knife; another makes you steam in the snow. Teams have ordered more.

stage.line: Erin stands by a crate of jars with a knife in one hand. A black-scaled Drake has just agreed to be stabbed. A crowd is gathering.
stage.note: M13.1: a scene. The text is on the street outside the Adventurers' Guild; liscor_market is the nearest map. Hours are guesses (afternoon). The player can help sell or talk Erin into a fair price.

hooks.news: Erin nearly sold her magic soups for pocket change. Another Human at the stall talked her into a fair price.

canon_ref.note: Day 100 is a guess (ADR 0020). Defence soup: red-purple, maybe the 3.15 thickskin soup (not stated). Warming soup: blue, not the orange corusdeer_soup. Soups spoil in about a week. Flags only, no items (user choice). The adventurer team is unnamed.

b5.g_erin_sells_soup_samples_at_the_guil.summary: Erin hands out soup samples by the Adventurers' Guild. She stabs a volunteer Drake to prove one soup stops blades, and Relc punches him too. A blue soup makes a swordswoman steam in the cold. Selys and the crowd tell Erin she is charging far too little, and the teams order more for tomorrow.

canon_ref.note: Day 100 is a guess (ADR 0020). She plans a meat hotpot for dinner.

b5.h_erin_watches_the_north_road.summary: Erin walks home and stands on the hill looking up the road to the northwest. She has heard Ryoka is coming, and she wants to be there when she does.

b5.i_ryoka_is_a_day_from_celum.rumor: A Runner on the road south of Invrisil was seen running hard through the snow with something cold and glittering at her shoulder.

canon_ref.note: Day 100 is a guess (ADR 0020). The Frost Faerie is unnamed, so not linked to Ivolethe. Reynold broke an axle on bandits; our data does not track him with her. She does not know about the door.

b5.i_ryoka_is_a_day_from_celum.summary: Ryoka is one hard day's run from Liscor, nearer Celum, with a Frost Faerie for company. She does not yet know about the door that could take her straight to Erin.

system.name: [Barmaid]
system.note: Her level as she tells Erin; not a new level.
